definitions: A large, heavily built plant-eating mammal with one or two horns on the snout and thick folded skin, native to Africa and Asia.
A genus of rhinoceroses, Rhinoceros, containing the Indian rhinoceros and Javan rhinoceros.
examples: The rhinoceros charged across the savanna.
Conservation efforts are crucial for the rhinoceros population.
A baby rhinoceros is called a calf.
